build_detectron2_package: build the detectron2 package with CUDA extensions and model zoo configs using setup.py
get_version_detectron2: get the detectron2 version string from __init__.py with optional nightly build suffix
get_extensions_detectron2: get the C++ and CUDA extension modules for the detectron2._C native library
get_model_zoo_configs_detectron2: get the list of model zoo config YAML and Python files for the package
review_setup_py: review the detectron2 setup.py to understand dependencies, extensions, and project sub-packages
